v2-1768906665251-ib69m7ql4.name: Auriga Prime
v2-1768906665251-ib69m7ql4.description: A vibrant alien planet with bioluminescent flora, floating islands, and crystalline rock formations.
v2-1768906665251-ib69m7ql4.weather: mild with a gentle, iridescent mist

v2-1768906665251-9skqj0xyr.name: The Sky-Archipelago
v2-1768906665251-9skqj0xyr.description: A collection of large, floating islands connected by organic bridges, teeming with exotic alien life.

v2-1768906665251-k1p1s3e4f.name: The Explorer's Outpost
v2-1768906665251-k1p1s3e4f.description: A geodesic dome station nestled on the edge of a floating island, with large panoramic windows revealing the alien landscape.

v2-1768906710626-mmwcpi4em.name: The Explorer's Outpost
v2-1768906710626-mmwcpi4em.description: A geodesic dome station perched on the edge of a floating island, offering panoramic views of an alien world. It serves as a hub for scientific research and exploration.
forbiddenTransformations: Removing the geodesic dome structure entirely
Replacing the alien landscape with a generic terrestrial environment
Adding medieval or fantasy architectural elements
Introducing modern Earth-based vehicles or technology
Changing the sky to a clear blue daytime sky
Removing the mist and flora from the exterior

v2-1768906710626-k9n0fi46p.name: Main Habitation Chamber
v2-1768906710626-k9n0fi46p.description: The central, enclosed living and working space within the geodesic dome. Warm lights emanate from integrated panels, illuminating scientific equipment and comfortable furnishings.
forbiddenTransformations: Exposing the raw exterior alien landscape or sky directly
Introducing visible cracks or damage to the dome structure
Replacing scientific equipment with domestic furniture
Allowing harsh, direct sunlight to enter the chamber
Adding dirt, dust, or organic overgrowth within the chamber
Making the interior feel cavernous or exposed
Using overly bright or sterile white lighting

v2-1768906806075-pr4zsad26.name: Observation Chamber
v2-1768906806075-pr4zsad26.description: This chamber offers a breathtaking, curved perspective of the alien vista through the dome's reinforced, transparent panels. It is a space designed for focused viewing and data collection.

banned: organic plant life within the chamber

forbiddenTransformations: The transparent dome panels should not become opaque or covered in moss.
The internal structure should not be rendered as rough-hewn rock or exposed to the open sky.
The chamber should not contain any signs of natural flora or fauna from the alien landscape.
The advanced technological elements should not be replaced with primitive or antique designs.
The lighting should remain soft and integrated, not resembling natural sunlight or open flames.
The overall shape of the chamber should adhere to the geodesic dome's interior curvature, not become a standard rectangular room.
The view through the panels should remain consistent with the exterior alien landscape and sky.

v2-1768907048796-34082rq5q.name: Through the Window
v2-1768907048796-34082rq5q.description: View: The world outside seen through the window - the alien landscape, unusual flora, and possibly distant planetary formations.
